_about: Regulatory items being tracked because they could move the value of listings in their jurisdiction. Updated by scripts/watch_regulatory.py on the weekly cron; the UI surfaces 'last_checked' and 'status' on the home screen via the 📜 chip.

items.name: Conservation Amendment Bill
items.why_watching: Amendments to NZ Conservation Act 1987 can shift DOC land boundaries, conservation concession rules, and what private parcels adjacent to public conservation land can do. Material for NZ rural / coastal listings.
items.last_status_note: http 200; bot-signature: radware — open the URL manually to check status

items.name: Prohibition on the Purchase of Residential Property by Non-Canadians Act
items.why_watching: Currently blocks non-Canadians from buying residential property in CMAs. Scheduled to expire 1 Jan 2027 unless extended. Sunset would re-open Canadian residential land to foreign buyers, likely pushing prices up. Watch for extension announcements.

items.name: BC Speculation and Vacancy Tax
items.issuer: Government of BC — Ministry of Finance
items.why_watching: 0.5%-2% annual tax on residential property in designated areas. Designated areas have expanded twice (2024 + 2025) and the program keeps growing. Affects rental viability of BC vacation properties and the math on holding undeveloped BC land in a regulated area.

items.name: BC Short-Term Rental Accommodations Act (Bill 35)
items.issuer: Government of BC — Ministry of Housing
items.why_watching: Restricts short-term rentals to principal residence + one secondary suite in many BC communities. Materially affects the rental yield of any BC vacation property — a key part of why some Whistler / Tofino / Okanagan listings are priced where they are.

items.name: Overseas Investment Act (residential land rules)
items.issuer: Land Information NZ (LINZ) — Overseas Investment Office
items.why_watching: Post-2018 amendments effectively block most non-resident foreign buyers from acquiring NZ residential land. Current government has signalled willingness to reopen for high-value buyers — any softening would re-price NZ coastal land upward.

items.name: Resource Management Act reform
items.why_watching: RMA is being replaced. New planning regime will redraw what's buildable on coastal NZ land, hazard-zone setbacks, and sea-level-rise rules. Direct impact on NZ coastal listings.

items.name: Underused Housing Tax (1% annual)
items.why_watching: 1% annual tax on vacant/underused residential property owned by non-resident non-Canadians (and some Canadians). Stacks with BC's spec/vacancy tax. Filing obligations + audit risk affect non-resident landlords directly.

items.name: Vacant Houses Special Measures Act (空家対策特別措置法)
items.issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT)
items.why_watching: Japan's framework for designating dangerous/derelict vacant houses. Once designated 'specified vacant house', the property loses the 6× residential property-tax reduction and the municipality can force demolition. Materially affects yields + carrying costs for the abandoned-ski-resort and akiya inventory.

items.name: Thai nominee crackdown — DBD + court enforcement
items.issuer: Department of Business Development (DBD) + Department of Special Investigation (DSI)
items.why_watching: DBD has flagged 11,426 companies on Koh Phangan + Koh Samui (~68% of all firms there) and identified 7,000+ businesses suspected of using Thai nationals as nominee shareholders to bypass the 49% foreign-ownership cap. Real estate is the primary target. If courts order unwinding within 6-12 months, ~2,400-3,000 nominee-suspect villas in Phuket and same number in Samui will hit the market. Affects every landed villa + Thai-company-held land listing — especially in Phuket west coast, Samui north/east, Phangan, Pattaya, Hua Hin.
